summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026, reporting quarterly earnings results, adoption of an Executive Annual Incentive Plan effective January 1, 2026, and declaration of a $0.07 per share dividend payable May 20, 2026. The filing covers routine operational, compensatory, and dividend actions with no terms or events suggesting a special situation. Items 2.02, 5.02, and 8.01 involve earnings, plan adoption, and dividend, all ordinary course. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring activity is present. The filing is a standard current report with no special-situation trigger.
